Players Committee card image of [[Kylo Ren With Lightsaber (ALT)]] (original printing), game text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Permanent weapon is •Kylo's Lightsaber (may target a character for free; draw two destiny; target hit, its forfeit = 0, and opponent loses 1 Force, if total destiny > defense value; otherwise you lose 1 Force).”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/kylorenwithlightsaber_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/793bf6567aab6b7f98de47650aedffa0d0097f93 793bf65] (15 January 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
